title: observability: add token-level KV cache metrics, tracing spans, dashboards & alert tuning
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: provide token-level visibility into KV cache behavior (hits, misses, evictions) and associated latency/cost contribution to help teams tune batching, caching, and routing policies. This PR exposes new Prometheus metrics for KV cache behavior, instruments tracing spans for cache lookup/write paths, adds a Grafana token-level dashboard for cost/latency breakdowns (KV cache + runtime), and tunes alert rules to reduce noise while surfacing regressions. Changes are behind a feature flag (obs.kv_token_metrics) and include docs and runbook links. Checklist: [x] Expose per-model KV cache metrics; [x] Add tracing spans for cache lookup/write; [x] Add Grafana dashboard JSON; [x] Add alert rules and runbook links; [x] Integration tests for metrics; [x] Docs and example queries; [x] CI green and reviewers approved. Impact: Observability only; no user-facing API change when feature flag is off. When enabled, operators will see token-level rows in the dashboard and get more accurate cost attribution for cache hits/misses which should help lower unit costs by enabling smarter batching and cache sizing decisions.
commits: feat(obs): expose kv_cache.hit_count and kv_cache.evictions per-model (runtime/metrics)
feat(tracing): add spans for kv_cache.lookup and kv_cache.write with attributes: model, trace_id, request_id, tokens
chore(dashboards): add kv-token-level Grafana dashboard and example queries (observability/grafana)
chore(alerts): add kv-cache alert rules and runbook links; adjust thresholds to reduce flapping
test: add integration test for Prometheus metrics and end-to-end dashboard smoke test
docs: document kv token metrics, example PromQL, and runbook steps
review_comments: Liam Chen: Can you confirm the metric labels and units are stable across model variants? Also requested explicit unit tests for eviction counting.
Asha Patel: Unit tests added and eviction counter normalized to per-token basis; labels include model, zone, and instance_type as discussed.
Priya Desai: Please add runbook link for kv-cache-high-evictions alert and reduce sensitivity for small tenants; also suggested switching alerting window to 5m->15m for lower noise.
Asha Patel: Updated alert rules with tenant-size based thresholds and added runbook entries. Adjusted window to 10m for initial rollout as a compromise.
Carlos Mendez (SRE): Integration tests look good but one integration test was flaky on first run; reran CI and it passed. Approving after CI green.
Liam Chen: Approve pending small naming nit in PromQL which was fixed in latest commit. Approved.
merge_info: Merged via squash by Asha Patel. All reviewers approved. Feature gated behind obs.kv_token_metrics flag. Dashboard JSON and alert rules included in release bundle.
release_notes: - Add token-level KV cache metrics (hit_count, miss_count, evictions) and latency breakdowns; - Instrument tracing spans for kv cache operations to correlate requests with cache behavior; - New Grafana dashboard for token-level cost/latency attribution and example PromQL queries; - Alert tuning: tenant-aware thresholds and runbook links; - Feature gated behind obs.kv_token_metrics; no default runtime change.
notes: Rollout plan: feature flag off by default; enable in staging for 2 weeks, monitor kv eviction alerts and latency regressions; then enable in canary for a subset of tenants before global rollout. Dashboard saved with version v1.0 and a migration note; operations should import dashboard JSON into Grafana for managed instances.
